notes:
Bugfixes:

- Site One Channel mode now fully replaces the stored Site/Page selection instead of only hiding Page controls, so the next started supported Site channel becomes the complete single-channel test plan and old Site/Page values can no longer re-enter the queue.
- The Site branch of the long-check starter now respects an explicit One Channel plan override just like the IPTV branch.
- Release Notes keyboard/Yatse navigation no longer forces focus onto the non-focusable scroll-capture control; Right enters Notes scrolling, Up/Down scrolls, and Left returns directly to the Release Notes tab.

Important:

- No Dorcel playback, predictive restart, IPTV group logic, long-check timing, Check Lock, AlarmClock/watchdog, log-copy, Save Log Only or shutdown behaviour was changed in this release.
